topic: Explaining why the world's biggest basketball hoop is surprisingly difficult to shoot into.

hook.first_words: This is the biggest basketball hoop
hook.first_frame: A man preparing to throw an orange basketball toward a massive blue basketball hoop outdoors.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: THIS IS THE BIGGEST BASKETBALL HOOP IN THE WORLD

script: This is the biggest basketball hoop in the world and at first you probably think nobody could miss on a 30 foot rim this huge, but somehow almost everyone who tries it for the first time ends up missing. Even Lethal Shooter who's famous for being insanely accurate couldn't make it on his first attempt. It actually took him three tries before he finally knocked one down on the world's largest hoop.
what_makes_it_work: Features a visually striking, oversized object that immediately grabs scrollers' attention.
Presents a counter-intuitive fact: big targets can actually trick perception and lead to misses.
Includes a recognized basketball personality (Lethal Shooter) to add credibility and social proof.
